# FTDI D2XX

This directory contains the [FTDI D2XX library][ftdi_lib] and the [FTDI MPSSE I2C & SPI libraries][ftdi_mpsse_lib]. They are kept here for usage in the CI pipeline.

These libraries are redistributed under the terms of the accompanying FTDI [LICENSE][LICENSE]. For further details, refer to the [Driver License Terms - Details][license_details].
